releases.desc: Flash Games is now a real single-page glass interface wired back into the legacy catalogue, Firebase account system, moderation tools, and Confer social experience.
items: Restored the real legacy Store catalogue and offline collection
Integrated Firebase profile data, authentication, notifications, and admin moderation
Added the Confer social section at its requested endpoint
Added migrated repository update history to the Updates view
Replaced the old Arc+ branding with Flash Games
Rebuilt search, library, game launching, settings, and notifications around real data
Added deployment version detection and stale-cache invalidation before reload
Removed fake Player identity, fake catalogue entries, and fake activity messages
Initial direct home dashboard and library
Initial Store and local library separation
Introduced the v2 liquid-glass visual system
